entities.name: HashMME
entities.description: Information element included by MME when initiating SECURITY MODE COMMAND during attach or tracking area updating procedure under specific security conditions.

entities.name: SECURITY MODE COMMAND
entities.description: Message sent by MME to initiate security mode control procedure.

entities.name: Attach procedure
entities.description: Procedure for UE to attach to the network.

entities.name: Tracking area updating procedure
entities.description: Procedure for UE to update its tracking area information.

entities.name: ATTACH REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to initiate attach procedure.

entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to initiate tracking area updating procedure.

entities.name: No integrity protection or failed integrity check
entities.description: Condition where ATTACH REQUEST or TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message was received without integrity protection or did not pass integrity check at MME.

relations.description: SECURITY MODE COMMAND message contains HashMME information element under specific conditions.
Inclusion of HashMME IE is guarded by the condition that ATTACH REQUEST or TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST was received without integrity protection or failed integrity check.
Condition applies to ATTACH REQUEST message.
Condition applies to TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message.
Attach procedure includes ATTACH REQUEST message.
Tracking area updating procedure includes TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message.
SECURITY MODE COMMAND is initiated during attach procedure.
SECURITY MODE COMMAND is initiated during tracking area updating procedure.
